about.title: About Us
about.heroDesc: We know what it means to be far from home and face the bureaucracy of an unfamiliar country.
about.storyText1: relocant.help was born from personal experience — the founders went through the challenges of relocation themselves and understood how hard it is to find a reliable specialist who speaks your language and understands your situation.
about.storyText2: Today we're building a platform where every specialist is manually verified, and the quality of help matters more than the number of listings.
about.value1Desc: Every specialist goes through license, language, and reference checks.
about.value2Desc: You can communicate in Ukrainian or Russian.
about.value3Desc: Clear prices with no hidden fees — payment only after the consultation.
about.value4Desc: From specialist matching to case completion, we're available.
